No hardware profile for {vendor}/{architecture}.

NeuroBrix reads every hardware-dependent value (block sizes, shared-memory limits,
precision support) from a per-architecture profile, and refuses to guess them: a
guessed block size produces wrong output, not an error.

Your GPU was detected as: {vendor} / {architecture}
Profiles available:       {known}

If your GPU is one NeuroBrix should support, this is a gap on our side, not a
limit of your hardware — please open an issue naming the architecture above.
Expected profile path:   {config_path}

What closing this gap needs — one YAML at the path above, with values READ FROM
the vendor's own specification, never estimated from a neighbouring part:
  architecture, compute_capability   identity, so the profile can be resolved
  memory.max_shared_memory_per_block the binding constraint on every autotune tile
  memory.max_registers_per_block, memory.warp_size
  block_sizes.{{gemm,bmm,conv2d}}      starting tiles, sized to the budget above
  pipelining.max_num_stages          conservative until measured on the card
`config/vendors/nvidia/volta.yml` is the worked reference; apple_silicon.yml shows
how a profile records that its values are documentation-sourced and unmeasured.
